## Purpose
`/knowledge`: the Knowledge page. Its tabs cover build guidance, reference knowledge, the sources the items were distilled from, and retrieval testing.

## Responsibilities
`KnowledgePage`:
- reads `knowledgeApi.counts` for the tab badges;
- tabs: `GuidancePanel`, `KnowledgeTab` (from ontology), `SourcesPanel` and `RetrievalPanels`.

Titled "Knowledge — Agentic AI Design Patterns".
